code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = 9
    # Full-width/full-height colored lines partition the canvas.
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and grid[0][c] != bg]
    # Identify equal-sized compartments between divider lines.
    rs = [0] + [r+1 for r in hr]
    re = hr + [h]
    cs = [0] + [c+1 for c in vc]
    ce = vc + [w]
    tiles = [(a,b,c,d) for a,b in zip(rs,re) for c,d in zip(cs,ce)]
    # Source is the compartment containing the most non-background cells.
    a,b,c,d = max(tiles, key=lambda t: sum(x != bg for row in grid[t[0]:t[1]] for x in row[t[2]:t[3]]))
    pattern = [row[c:d] for row in grid[a:b]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ra, rb in zip(rs,re):
        for ca, cb in zip(cs,ce):
            for i in range(min(rb-ra, len(pattern))):
                for j in range(min(cb-ca, len(pattern[i]))):
                    out[ra+i][ca+j] = pattern[i][j]
    return out
'''
open(os.path.join(p,'task-884bcfb5.py'),'w').write(code)
print('saved')
